description: Main source file for a Flutter-based mobile todo app, defining the app's UI, state management, persistence via SQLite, and user interactions.

classes.name: TodoApp
classes.description: Stateless widget that sets up the MaterialApp with theming and home screen.

classes.name: TodoHomeScreen
classes.description: Stateful widget managing the main task list UI with bottom navigation and task management actions.

classes.name: _TodoHomeScreenState
classes.description: State class for TodoHomeScreen, handles navigation, task list display, and task manipulation dialogs.

classes.name: TodoCard
classes.description: Widget representing each individual todo item, supporting marking complete, editing, and deleting.

classes.name: TodoItem
classes.description: Data class representing a task item with fields like title, details, completion status, and timestamp.

classes.name: TodoDatabaseHelper
classes.description: Singleton helper class abstracting SQLite database operations: create, read, update, delete.

classes.name: TodoProvider
classes.description: ChangeNotifier-based provider class maintaining the list of todos and synchronizing with database.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point initializing Flutter bindings, loading environment variables, setting device orientation, and running the root widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for the TodoApp widget, configuring MaterialApp with theme and home screen.

methods.name: _TodoHomeScreenState.build
methods.description: Build method for the main task list UI, including app bar, list of tasks, bottom navigation, and FAB.

methods.name: _showAddOrEditTodo
methods.description: Method to display bottom sheet for creating or editing a task, handling input and actions.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method of TodoCard, rendering individual task with checkbox, title, details, and swipe-to-delete.

calls: Database methods: getAllTodos, addTodo, updateTodo, deleteTodo
